title: Concept: Identity token claims disclosed with internal roles
description: A decoded identity token whose claims include internal group or role names in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The claims name the identity groups a workforce account belongs to, which is the authorisation map an attacker uses to choose a target account.
applicability: Deployments that render a decoded identity token whose claims include internal group or role names into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The claims name the identity groups a workforce account belongs to, which is the authorisation map an attacker uses to choose a target account.
